decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - GRANT - Permitted DevelopmentReason:The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that the proposed hip to gable roof extension with rear dormers 2.7m (width) x 3.1m (depth) x 2.2m (high) and 2.2m (width) x 3.9m  (depth) x 2.5m (high) received on the 11 August 2009, and verified on site on the 3 September 2009, as shown on the plan 09/01 received 11 August 2009 and the amended drawing submitted on 28 September 2009 and numbered 09/02 was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:The development complies with the terms of Schedule 2, Part 1, Classes B and C, of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (as amended in 2008) because the roof extension is permitted development.

Informative:
1	In order for this application to be lawful the materials used in the exterior work shall be of a similar appearance to those used in the construction of the exterior of the existing house.
2	In order for this application to be lawful the roof lights on the front plane of the roof must not protrude more than 150mm beyond the plane of the slope of the original roof when measured from the perpendicular with the external surface of the original roof.
3	In order for this development to be lawful, the edge of the enlargement of the rear roof space closest to the eaves of the original roof shall be not less than 20cm from the outside plane of the new approved gable.  If this is not so, then the works are not covered by the Certificate and are not lawful.
4	In order for this development to be lawful, the proposed roof extension must not be higher than any part of the existing ridge of the roof.  The original ridgeline and ridge capping of the house should be maintained.  If this height is exceeded, the works are not covered by the Certificate and are not Lawful.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for a proposed rear roof extension and installation of 2 roof lights to front elevation.
